hyp.code_patch:
import numpy as np
import train
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    groups=np.asarray(df[train.SITE])
    idx=np.arange(len(df))
    tr,te=next(GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1,test_size=0.25,random_state=seed).split(idx,groups=groups))
    f=train.feats(df)
    X=df[f].to_numpy()
    y=df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    corrs=[]
    for j in range(X.shape[1]):
        xj=X[:,j].astype(float)
        if np.std(xj)==0 or np.std(groups.astype(float))==0:
            corrs.append(0.0)
        else:
            c=np.corrcoef(xj,groups.astype(float))[0,1]
            corrs.append(float(abs(c)) if np.isfinite(c) else 0.0)
    drop_idx=int(np.argmax(corrs))
    keep=[c for i,c in enumerate(f) if i!=drop_idx]
    Xtr=df[keep].to_numpy()[tr]
    Xte=df[keep].to_numpy()[te]
    ytr=y[tr]
    yte=y[te]
    y_pred=train.fit_predict(Xtr,ytr,Xte,seed)
    return (yte, y_pred)
